name: claude-colab
description: Development tasks of the colab mod and the claude-colab CLI; the plugin itself has no dependencies.

scripts.check: echo "node $(node --version), pinned $(cat .node-version)" && pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:sh && pnpm typecheck && pnpm guard && pnpm test:node && pnpm test:mod
scripts.lint:sh: command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || { echo 'No shellcheck: install it apart (Homebrew: brew install shellcheck), since the gate lints the git hooks with it' >&2; exit 1; } && shellcheck .githooks/*
scripts.typecheck: test -f plugins/colab/.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json || { echo 'No engine types yet: run claude --plugin-dir plugins/colab once, which writes them to plugins/colab/.claude-plugin/types/' >&2; exit 1; } && tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json
